messages:
Mia Chen: FYI — Dovetail Labs (acct DVL-112) spiked hosted API usage this morning. Auto-flag fired at ~09:12 UTC, saw a ~42% overshoot of their monthly commit in a 120m window.

Raj Patel: Oof. Any latency or error signals tied to that? throttles?

Mia Chen: Latency stable, error rate unchanged. We did see increased 429s towards the tail-end of the burst (small percentage). Looks like token volume + request rate, not model errors.

Elena Gomez: Quick query I ran:```sql
-- last 3h token totals by route
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as toks, COUNT(*) as reqs
FROM api_events
WHERE account = 'DVL-112' AND ts >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY toks DESC
```
Top route is /v1/completions-rerank; rerank batch jobs kicked off after their nightly job changed model last Wed.

BillingBot: ALERT: commit breach detected for DVL-112. Current month usage: 142% of committed tokens. Suggested next step: contact CS rep.

Mia Chen: Planning a 30m enablement at 16:00 PT to walk them through batching + KV cache recommendations. Two short mitigation options to propose: 
1) Temporary quota bump (+50% for 48h) while we tune their jobs.
2) Apply soft-throttle + billing notice and rapid follow-up with finance.

Raj Patel: I lean toward 1) to avoid immediate noise for their product. If they accept, we can avoid a renewal risk. @Samir can ops do a timed bump?

Samir Ali: Granting temporary +50% capacity for 48h now (CS-8473). I'll add a note for auto-revert. :white_check_mark:

Support Bot: Created ticket CS-8473: "DVL-112 temporary quota bump + post-mortem" — https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-8473

Elena Gomez: I'll draft a one-pager 'Budget playbook' with: batching patterns, prompt examples to cut tokens (stop sequences & truncation), and KV cache usage. Will share in #cs-docs by EOD.

Mia Chen: Action items: 
- Elena: playbook + example code snippets.
- Raj: prep renewal-risk note if we see repeat spikes (flag threshold: 120% for 7d).
- Samir: confirm revert scheduled and capture window metrics.
- Finance/CS: I'll route a pro-rated overage option to them after the enablement.

Raj Patel: I'll also include a small suggested billing cadence (pro-rated invoice + commit-top-up option) to keep renewal clean.

Mia Chen: Thanks all. I'll run the 16:00 PT session and post notes. Please react with :eyes: when you've seen the ticket or added slides.

Samir Ali: noted and logged metrics snapshot in ticket.

Elena Gomez: Uploaded draft playbook to CS drive: https://drive.redwood/cs/dovetail-playbook (link shared in ticket).

Mia Chen: closing loop — temp bump active, enablement scheduled, playbook shared. We'll reconvene if anomalies continue. :wave:
